facts.statement: A weekly community event focused on the JCC card game, player versus player; players can start games, join matches, trade cards or watch.
facts.quote: Este evento comunitario semanal se enfoca en el juego JCC, jugador contra jugador.

facts.statement: The JCC event session for US and Latin America was Friday 20 November, 15:00-17:00 Pacific time, on Server 1.
The JCC event session for UK and Europe was Friday 20 November, 09:00-11:00 Pacific time (18:00-20:00 local listed), on Server 1.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Reto JCC
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event post promoting a weekly player-versus-player Juego de Cartas de Coleccion (JCC, the in-game trading card game). It tells players to meet at Encrucijada (or enter the JCC lobby from anywhere) and gives a start point, NPC Mar Mita, with two timed sessions for different regions on Server 1.
